All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable, robocode.robotinterfaces.IAdvancedEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IAdvancedRobot, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicEvents2, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicEvents3, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicRobot, robocode.robotinterfaces.IInteractiveEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IInteractiveRobot, robocode.robotinterfaces.IPaintEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IPaintRobot
public class DeiseLab extends robocode.AdvancedRobot
The bench adapter: Deise driven by the core (hadur117.mini.core), call by call. It is the reference the shipped class Deise is held to (DEISE-16), and the source the bench arms are built from (hadur-bench/tools/deise_arms.sh). It also records the shots it sees fired, but their waves count for nothing since stage E0's smoke (Move.WAVES); arm W measures them. Built into its own jar (hadur117.mini.DeiseLab_<release>.jar); it never ships.
